description: Combined Python reviewed-bundle benchmark covering the strict V1 trio plus the SQLi and SSRF extension families.

cases.goal: Check whether the reviewed command-injection bundle reduces noisy sinks while preserving core RCE findings.
Check whether the reviewed path-traversal bundle shifts findings from path construction helpers toward real file-access sinks.
Check whether the reviewed deserialization bundle preserves sink coverage while adding reviewed provenance and sanitizer metadata.
Check whether the fixed default scanner and the reviewed SQLi bundle keep execute-family sink coverage aligned.
Check whether the reviewed SSRF bundle keeps outbound-request sink coverage aligned with the default scanner on the dedicated Python SSRF example.
